Argument.Label: &Input values
Argument.Description: The collection of values to concatenate.

Argument.Label: &Delimiter (optional)
Argument.Description: The delimiter to use between each value. A semicolon is used by default.

Argument.Label: &Omit last (optional)
Argument.Description: True to omit the delimiter after the last value. False to keep the last delimiter (this is the default).
